All imports are production classes only (no test helpers). All three test classes are self-contained, use JUnit 3.8 (`junit.framework.TestCase`, matching the rest of the project), avoid Java-8-incompatible syntax, and pass.

Summary of what was added:
- `src/test/org/apache/commons/cli2/WriteableCommandLineAgentTest.java` — tests the `WriteableCommandLine` interface contract (add/get option, value, switch, property, defaults, current-option tracking, `looksLikeOption`) via `WriteableCommandLineImpl`.
- `src/test/org/apache/commons/cli2/commandline/WriteableCommandLineImplAgentTest.java` — tests `WriteableCommandLineImpl`-specific behavior: ancestor auto-registration, trigger lookup, unmodifiable collections, value/switch default fallback order, `toString()`/`getNormalised()`, and the `looksLikeOption` re-entrancy guard.
- `src/test/org/apache/commons/cli2/option/GroupImplAgentTest.java` — tests `GroupImpl`: prefix/trigger aggregation, argument vs. anonymous separation, `canProcess`/`process`/`validate` (including too-many/too-few/missing-required error paths), `isRequired`, `appendUsage`, `helpLines`, and `defaults`.

All 65 tests across the three files pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
